spans.s:
vaidharm-ya, n. unlawfulness;
 dissimilarity, 🞄heterogeneousness: -sama, m. 🞄fallacy based on dissimilarity (in logic).

vaidhav-eya, m. son of a widow 🞄(vidhavā);
 -ya, n. widowhood: -veṇī, f. 🞄widowʼs braid.
vaidhātr-a, a. (ī) derived from Brahman 🞄or fate (vidhātṛ).

vaidheya, a. [afflicted by fate, vidhi] 🞄stupid, foolish;
 m. fool, idiot.
